content: I want an angular plate with two quadratic plates positioned in right angel to each other. The edge length of the plates is 140mm. They are 10mm thick. On one of the two plates I would like to have a quadratic cutout, 45x45mm, centred on the plate. | Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once

function_call.name: CreateCode
function_call.arguments: "{\"PythonCode\":\"# Calculate the positions and dimensions for the two plates and the cutout\\n\\n# Plate dimensions\\nedge_length = 140  # mm\\nthickness = 10     # mm\\ncutout_size = 45   # mm\\n\\n# First plate (horizontal)\\nplate1_x_size = edge_length\\nplate1_y_size = edge_length\\nplate1_z_size = thickness\\nplate1_x = 0\\nplate1_y = 0\\nplate1_z = 0\\n\\n# Second plate (vertical, attached to the first plate)\\nplate2_x_size = edge_length\\nplate2_y_size = thickness\\nplate2_z_size = edge_length\\nplate2_x = 0\\nplate2_y = 0\\nplate2_z = 0\\n\\n# Cutout on the first plate (centered)\\ncutout_x_size = cutout_size\\ncutout_y_size = cutout_size\\ncutout_z_size = thickness\\ncutout_x = (edge_length - cutout_size) / 2\\ncutout_y = (edge_length - cutout_size) / 2\\ncutout_z = 0\\n\\n# Output the values\\noutput = {\\n    \\\"plate1\\\": {\\\"x_size\\\": plate1_x_size, \\\"y_size\\\": plate1_y_size, \\\"z_size\\\": plate1_z_size, \\\"x\\\": plate1_x, \\\"y\\\": plate1_y, \\\"z\\\": plate1_z},\\n    \\\"plate2\\\": {\\\"x_size\\\": plate2_x_size, \\\"y_size\\\": plate2_y_size, \\\"z_size\\\": plate2_z_size, \\\"x\\\": plate2_x, \\\"y\\\": plate2_y, \\\"z\\\": plate2_z},\\n    \\\"cutout\\\": {\\\"x_size\\\": cutout_x_size, \\\"y_size\\\": cutout_y_size, \\\"z_size\\\": cutout_z_size, \\\"x\\\": cutout_x, \\\"y\\\": cutout_y, \\\"z\\\": cutout_z}\\n}\\noutput\"}"

{"PythonCode":"# Calculate the positions and dimensions for the two plates and the cutout

# Plate dimensions
edge_length = 140  # mm
thickness = 10     # mm
cutout_size = 45   # mm

# First plate (horizontal)
plate1_x_size = edge_length
plate1_y_size = edge_length
plate1_z_size = thickness
plate1_x = 0
plate1_y = 0
plate1_z = 0

# Second plate (vertical, attached to the first plate)
plate2_x_size = edge_length
plate2_y_size = thickness
plate2_z_size = edge_length
plate2_x = 0
plate2_y = 0
plate2_z = 0

# Cutout on the first plate (centered)
cutout_x_size = cutout_size
cutout_y_size = cutout_size
cutout_z_size = thickness
cutout_x = (edge_length - cutout_size) / 2
cutout_y = (edge_length - cutout_size) / 2
cutout_z = 0

# Output the values
output = {
    "plate1": {"x_size": plate1_x_size, "y_size": plate1_y_size, "z_size": plate1_z_size, "x": plate1_x, "y": plate1_y, "z": plate1_z},
    "plate2": {"x_size": plate2_x_size, "y_size": plate2_y_size, "z_size": plate2_z_size, "x": plate2_x, "y": plate2_y, "z": plate2_z},
    "cutout": {"x_size": cutout_x_size, "y_size": cutout_y_size, "z_size": cutout_z_size, "x": cutout_x, "y": cutout_y, "z": cutout_z}
}
